terminology_policy: LA=downstream Linux Android/vendor, LE=upstream Linux Embedded

deltas.la_pattern: LA spreads logic across wcd938x.c, wcd938x-slave.c, wcd938x-regmap.c, wcd938x-mbhc.c, and vendor-only internal headers.
deltas.le_pattern: LE splits into a codec aggregator (wcd938x.c), SoundWire slave/regmap file (wcd938x-sdw.c), shared helpers (wcd-common, wcd-mbhc-v2, wcd-clsh-v2), and shared register header.
deltas.why: LE split improves maintainability and removes duplicate framework code already provided by shared helpers.

deltas.la_pattern: LA platform probe consumes parent platform hooks, does static-supply enable, then binds slaves with explicit delays and custom teardown.
deltas.le_pattern: LE probe initializes DT/reset/supplies, adds component master match, then uses bind/unbind with device_link ordering and PM runtime setup.
deltas.why: LE lifecycle is generic and avoids vendor parent coupling.

deltas.la_pattern: LA uses legacy SWR driver naming ("wcd938x-slave") and manual logical dev-num polling with retries in slave bind.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses sdw_driver with standard sdw_device_id tuple and shared component ops + runtime PM hooks.
deltas.why: LE aligns with mainline SoundWire framework semantics and avoids vendor-specific SWR APIs.

deltas.la_pattern: LA registers/unregisters component around custom IRQ wrappers and vendor slave discovery helpers.
deltas.le_pattern: LE registers component after finding rx/tx SDW children and wiring device_link dependencies.
deltas.why: Component model is consistent across both, but LE ordering is cleaner and should be preserved.

deltas.la_pattern: LA initializes SWR regmap from tx slave using 16-bit reg addressing and REGCACHE_RBTREE.
deltas.le_pattern: LE initializes SDW regmap in SDW tx probe using 32-bit reg addressing and REGCACHE_MAPLE; starts cache-only before attach.
deltas.why: LE regmap lifecycle integrates with SDW attach state and runtime PM.

deltas.la_pattern: LA carries codec-specific MBHC wrapper code and API surface from vendor wcd-mbhc-v2-api.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses shared wcd-mbhc-v2 interfaces: wcd_mbhc_init/start/stop/deinit and common DT parsing helpers.
deltas.why: LE removes duplicated MBHC machinery and centralizes behavior in shared library code.

deltas.la_pattern: LA uses legacy class-H helper APIs and codec-local class-H sequencing in DAPM events.
deltas.le_pattern: LE allocates shared class-H controller (wcd_clsh_ctrl_alloc) and uses shared state API in DAPM event handlers.
deltas.why: LE class-H state machine is already accepted upstream and version-gated through shared enum.

deltas.la_pattern: LA reset path depends on qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node + msm_cdc_pinctrl state switching.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses standard GPIO descriptor reset-gpios (devm_gpiod_get with "reset") and direct toggle delays.
deltas.why: LE reset model is portable and does not depend on vendor pinctrl glue.

deltas.la_pattern: LA uses PM_SLEEP hooks to toggle supply LPM modes and custom status bits.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses runtime PM on both platform and SDW devices, plus regcache cache-only/sync transitions.
deltas.why: LE runtime PM pattern is framework-native and easier to verify.

deltas.la_pattern: LA uses wcd_irq_init/wcd_request_irq wrappers from vendor stack.
deltas.le_pattern: LE builds regmap-irq domain and requests threaded IRQs using core APIs.
deltas.why: Regmap-irq and threaded IRQ APIs are upstream-native and reduce vendor coupling.

deltas.la_pattern: LA and LE both contain rich DAPM/control sets (HPH/AUX/EAR/ADC/DMIC), but LA ties several flows to vendor-specific control hooks.
deltas.le_pattern: LE keeps similar topology but with cleaner control registration and shared class-H/MBHC calls from event handlers.
deltas.why: Signal topology is reusable, but control callbacks must use LE helper APIs.

deltas.la_pattern: LA uses legacy properties such as qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node, qcom,rx-slave, qcom,tx-slave, qcom,rx_swr_ch_map, qcom,tx_swr_ch_map, qcom,cdc-micbias*-mv.
deltas.le_pattern: LE expects qcom,rx-device/qcom,tx-device, qcom,rx-port-mapping/qcom,tx-port-mapping, reset GPIO descriptor, and qcom,micbias*-microvolt via shared helper.
deltas.why: LE DT schema is generic and not vendor-framework bound.

deltas.la_pattern: LA parses regulators through msm_cdc helper stack and toggles static/on-demand/LPM supplies.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses devm_regulator_bulk_get_enable in DT population and avoids vendor regulator wrappers.
deltas.why: Vendor supply orchestration is not upstreamable; LE keeps minimal generic regulator flow.

deltas.la_pattern: LA Kbuild is environment-conditional and architecture-specific with external module assumptions.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses normal codec Kconfig symbols and Makefile object wiring for core and SDW files.
deltas.why: LE integration is reproducible in mainline build systems.

deltas.la_pattern: LA keeps register map in dedicated wcd938x-registers.h plus access tables in wcd938x-tables.c and local regmap callbacks.
deltas.le_pattern: LE consolidates register definitions and SDW channel types in wcd938x.h and embeds register defaults/access callbacks in wcd938x-sdw.c.
deltas.why: Register completeness is retained, but placement follows LE split between shared header and SDW implementation.

deltas.la_pattern: LA depends on vendor APIs: wcdcal-hwdep, msm-cdc-pinctrl/supply, bolero internals, qti regmap debugfs, and parent callbacks.
deltas.le_pattern: LE depends on standard kernel/ASoC/SDW/regmap helpers plus shared WCD libraries.
deltas.why: These dependencies are platform/vendor specific and block upstream portability.

deltas.la_pattern: LA mixes ratelimited logs and returns while partially initialized vendor resources remain coupled to parent handles.
deltas.le_pattern: LE uses dev_err_probe patterns and goto unwind labels that mirror allocation order in bind/probe paths.
deltas.why: Structured unwind is directly reusable and safer for conversion automation.

deltas.la_pattern: LA carries explicit timing delays/retry behavior around enumeration and PA transitions that may be board/runtime sensitive.
deltas.le_pattern: LE contains some timing assumptions too, but no LA-specific runtime recovery hacks.
deltas.why: Do not infer WCD9378 runtime recovery policy from WCD938x static code; requires hardware logs.
